title: Hr Executive And Generalist
description:
Hiring HR Executive 
 Company: Wolf Technologies LLC
 Job Location: Mehsana, Gujarat
 Experience Required: 1–5 Years
 Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
 Work Mode: Work From Office
 Shift Timing: 7:30 PM – 4:30 AM (US Night Shift)
 Department: Human Resources (HR)
 Industry: Staffing & Recruitment 
 Job Summary Wolf Technologies LLC is looking for a dynamic, proactive, and experienced HR Executive to join our growing team in Mehsana, Gujarat. The ideal candidate should have experience in end-to-end recruitment, HR operations, employee engagement, and HR administration. The candidate must possess strong communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills and be comfortable working independently during US night-shift hours. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition Manage end-to-end recruitment, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding. Source suitable candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, job portals, and professional networks. Coordinate interviews with department heads and relevant stakeholders. Handle salary negotiations, offer letters, and joining formalities. Maintain recruitment trackers and ensure timely closure of open positions. Support recruitment requirements for the US staffing industry. 
 2. HR Operations & Administration Manage employee onboarding, documentation, and induction. Maintain accurate employee records, HR databases, and HR MIS reports. Monitor attendance, leave records, and HRMS updates. Coordinate payroll inputs and employee-related documentation. Ensure smooth day-to-day HR operations and adherence to company policies. 
 3. Employee Engagement & Relations Address employee queries, grievances, and workplace concerns professionally. Support employee engagement initiatives and maintain a positive work environment. Coordinate with employees and team leads to resolve HR-related issues. Ensure effective communication and compliance with internal HR policies. 
 4. HR Compliance Maintain statutory HR records and documentation. Assist with PF, ESIC, and other applicable statutory compliance requirements. Coordinate with relevant departments for audits and compliance-related activities. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field. 1–5 years of relevant experience in HR, recruitment, or HR operations. Strong knowledge of end-to-end recruitment and candidate sourcing. Good understanding of onboarding, employee relations, attendance, and payroll coordination. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal, negotiation, and problem-solving abilities. Proficiency in MS Excel, HRMS, and recruitment platforms. Ability to multitask, handle responsibilities independently, and meet deadlines. Basic knowledge of PF, ESIC, and labor laws is preferred. Experience in US recruitment or staffing will be an added advantage. 
 What We Offer Competitive salary package Professional growth and career development opportunities Exposure to the US staffing and recruitment industry Supportive and performance-driven work environment Opportunity to manage diverse HR responsibilities 
 Important Requirements Candidates must be comfortable working in the US Night Shift (7:30 PM – 4:30 AM) . This is a Work From Office opportunity based in Mehsana, Gujarat. Candidates from Mehsana, Visnagar, Patan, Unjha, Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar , and nearby locations who are willing to commute or relocate are encouraged to apply.

Key Skills: Payroll Management,Employee Engagement,End to End Recruitment,Joining Formalities,Appraisal Management,Exit Formalities,Leave Management,Onboarding
